Dear Medical AI company (e.g. Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Medical AI company (e.g..

## Technology
P-13 — ML-based predictor using ICP + flow trends to forecast failure 24h before

## Why This May Matter to Medical AI company (e.g., Caption Health, Cleerly) or large health system data science team
Shunt failure prediction from physiological data is a specific, high-value AI application. Neuromorphic implementation enables ultra-low-power on-device inference — critical for implantable context.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)

## What We Are Asking
Commission the decisive experiment ($5-15K (ESTIMATED: compute + data access)) OR request technical diligence OR request co-development discussion. Licensing is a subsequent route after successful validation.

A defined experiment ($$0-5K (if dataset available), 3-6 months to T2 with data) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular

3_buyer_specific_reason.ideal_buyer: Medical AI company (e.g., Caption Health, Cleerly) or large health system data science team
3_buyer_specific_reason.strategic_reason: Shunt failure prediction from physiological data is a specific, high-value AI application. Neuromorphic implementation enables ultra-low-power on-device inference — critical for implantable context.
3_buyer_specific_reason.why_this_buyer_would_care: Data partnership opportunity. The buyer brings the dataset; we bring the mechanism and hypothesis. If AUC >= 0.80 is achievable, this is a productizable prediction service. The neuromorphic angle is the differentiator vs generic medical AI.
3_buyer_specific_reason.capabilities_required: Clinical data access (shunt patient datasets), ML/AI engineering, neuromorphic hardware expertise, FDA AI/ML regulatory pathway experience

5_nda_cda_trigger.trigger_point: When buyer requests full technical dossier (07_PREMIUM_DOSSIER.json) or evidence ledger
5_nda_cda_trigger.what_is_shared_pre_nda: This one-page summary + executive email. No proprietary data, no full evidence ledger, no model code.
5_nda_cda_trigger.what_is_shared_post_nda: Full 15-section dossier, evidence ledger with source artifacts, experiment protocols, model code references, competitive analysis, IP diligence status.
5_nda_cda_trigger.nda_template_note: Use standard mutual NDA. CereVascular provides technology disclosure; buyer provides evaluation feedback. Both sides protect confidential information.
5_nda_cda_trigger.timeline_for_nda: Typically executed within 1-2 weeks of initial interest expression

6_technical_diligence_path.step_1_initial_review: Buyer reviews one-page summary + executive email (30 min)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_3_full_dossier_review: Buyer's technical team reviews full dossier + evidence ledger (1-2 weeks)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_4_technical_qa: Conference call with CereVascular technical team (1 hour)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_5_validation_decision: Buyer decides: commission validation experiment, request co-development, or pass
6_technical_diligence_path.step_6_if_validation: Buyer funds experiment → external party executes → data ingested via R341 pipeline → T2 upgrade → license discussion
6_technical_diligence_path.step_7_if_license: Term sheet negotiation → exclusive license or co-development agreement
6_technical_diligence_path.estimated_total_timeline: 4-8 weeks from initial contact to validation decision; 3-6 months from validation to license

validation_investment.experiment: External dataset validation: obtain shunt patient dataset (clinical partner or MIMIC-IV), train/test predictor, measure AUC on held-out set.
validation_investment.success_threshold: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)
validation_investment.co_validation_strategy: Data partnership: buyer provides dataset → we validate → if AUC ≥ 0.80 → co-development → exclusive license. Buyer retains data rights.
